title: Release slice crafting and stakeholder signoff path
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Objective: Produce a staged, audience-aware release package for console-2026.03 that includes (1) an internal launch brief for CS/SE/TS/Eng, (2) a tiered public changelog with short and expanded variants, and (3) machine-readable change slices for SDKs and partner portals. Scope covers content drafting, redaction rules, legal/marketing signoff, localization blurbs (EN/FR/DE), and ops handoff including runbooks and rollback notes. This ticket orchestrates owners, timelines, and the signoff path rather than authoring every blurb across features.
acceptance_criteria: Internal launch brief created and published to Confluence with owner contact list and emergency rollback steps
Public changelog delivered in two variants: Compact (customer-facing) and Expanded (developer-focused), with markdown files in the repo and a rendered version in the release portal
Legal & Security approvals recorded as comments or links to signed docs before public release
Localization vendor has received source strings and confirmed delivery ETA for EN/FR/DE
Ops readiness checklist completed: runbook attached, monitoring dashboards linked, on-call rotations notified
A lightweight machine-readable change slice (JSON manifest) produced and landed in sdk-change-manifests/ with version and impact tags

decisions: Two-tier changelog format accepted: Compact (single-paragraph entries, aimed at end customers) and Expanded (developer-focused with links and upgrade notes)
Machine-readable change slices will follow schema-v1 and be published under sdk-change-manifests/ with semantic tags (impact: low/medium/high)
Embargo policy: internal brief distributed T-3 days; public changelog goes live T (publish date). Exceptions require Exec signoff
Redaction policy: remove internal endpoint names, customer-specific telemetry, and PII from public blurbs; Legal owner will annotate any residual risk items
